title: 城关 水关 Chengguan shuiguan
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.7 m, eave 4.4 m, ridge 9.06 m above the ground
hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 7 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, right, 歇山 hip-and-gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考: 城关 水关
Scene 34, 别有洞天 Bieyou Dongtian
evidence.excerpt_other: It led, as through a cave, to "another sky" and to a small lake surrounded by houses called Hsiu Ch'ing Ts'un, or Beautiful Pure Village.
evidence.summary: A fortified water gate over the stream behind the hill at the south-east corner of 福海, leading to a small lake and 秀清村 Xiuqing Cun.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 3x3 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
